## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests or validation evidence added/updated.
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or interfaces changed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or customer material included.
- [ ] Third-party code/assets are identified with source and license.
- [ ] Required notices and modification statements are preserved.
- [ ] Commits include DCO `Signed-off-by`.
- [ ] License coverage remains valid (`Apache-2.0` for first-party work).

## Risk and rollback

Describe security, compatibility, deployment or data risks and how to reverse the change.
